InstallPrivacy

Let’s get you reading.

Start with these checks. For a question or a bug report, contact the publisher through Sergei Nikolenko’s profile. Include your macOS, browser, and Lunori versions plus the visible error. Do not send credentials or private page text.

Companion disconnected

Confirm Node.js 22+ is installed, open your browser once, and run zsh Install.command again from the extracted macOS package. If Node moved or was upgraded to a different installation path, rerun the installer.

No models or sign-in required

In Lunori, choose Continue with ChatGPT and authorize plan usage. Reopen Lunori. You can also use Connect another account in its account menu. Model availability comes from your account.

Translation is slow or fails

Try Standard with a smaller available model. Check your shared ChatGPT usage limits. Restore the original and retry. Large pages translate visible paragraphs first and continue as you scroll.

Nothing happens on a page

Chrome protects browser settings, extension stores, and some built-in pages. Test on an ordinary HTTPS article. This release does not translate PDFs, images, video, or editable form fields.

The toolbar is hidden

Open the browser extension popup and click Show toolbar. On an already activated page, Alt+Shift+H also works.

What to expect

Lunori is an independent early release. There is no paid Lunori subscription or guaranteed support response time. Store review and broader platform support are still pending.
